name: network-diagnostics
description: Check connectivity: DNS, gateway reachability, and latency.
steps: resolve DNS for a well-known host
measure latency to gateway and internet host
report a verdict: local issue, DNS issue, or upstream issue
validation: verdict names exactly one of local/dns/upstream
failure_recovery: report which probe failed and suggest the manual command
cautions: diagnostic probes only: ping and DNS lookups, no port scans
never probe hosts the user did not name or imply
